candidates: When the content of a documentation section is updated or expanded, review its heading to ensure it accurately describes all topics now covered; rename headings that have become too narrow or misleading relative to the new content.

When linking to another documentation page, include a fragment identifier (e.g. `[Link Text](../path/to/page.md#anchor-name)`) to point directly to the relevant subsection rather than the top of the page, so readers land precisely at the referenced content.

Documentation markdown files under `packages/mermaid/src/docs/` are linted by Prettier; run `npx prettier --write <file>` on any modified docs file before committing to avoid linter failures on indentation and formatting.
